headline: Fresh Base Fighting Rouses the Central Front
war_summary: The latest ledger shows the front quickening in several sectors since the previous edition. Callums Cape remains the war’s busiest station, rising to 46 base events in 24 hours and two in the latest two-hour window; its holdings now include three Warden, three Colonial and one neutral base. Mooring County has climbed to 35 daily events, with six recently recorded, while Wardens still hold 10 of 12 positions. Linn Mercy has registered 30 events in the day and three in two hours, retaining seven Colonial, three Warden and one neutral base. Weathered Expanse has also stirred, reaching 24 daily events and six in the latest six-hour span, with six Warden, one Colonial and two neutral positions. Marban Hollow is active again, recording three events in two hours and 20 across the day, while its eight bases remain divided between three Wardens, three Colonials and two neutral sites. Lykos Isle, previously less prominent, has posted five events in two hours. Stonecradle remains a recorded flashpoint but has gone quiet in the latest window.
